description: Ranked picks for an occasion, using Festiv's scoring (no guesswork): date_night, anniversary, birthday, first_date, family_kids, team_outing, after_work, girls_night_out, friends_hangout, tourist_day, foodie_tour, wellness, ramadan_iftar, cny_celebration, quick_bite, late_night, solo_explorer, vibe_explorer, surprise. Give a neighbourhood, city or landmark; optional budget (low, mid, high), party size, time (tonight, this_weekend, a date), cuisine and halal. Each pick says why it fits.

area.description: Neighbourhood or district name, e.g. 'Bangsar', 'KLCC', 'George Town'. A name Festiv does not know is refused, not guessed; a city or region word such as 'Penang' or 'Klang Valley' is read as a city.
area.title: Area

city.description: City when no neighbourhood is known, e.g. 'Kuala Lumpur', 'Petaling Jaya', 'Penang'.
city.title: City

halal.description: True = only venues with a verified halal certificate; when none qualifies the reply carries a `note`.
halal.title: Halal

language.description: Reply language for summaries: en, ms (Malay) or zh (Chinese). Venue names stay in their original script.
language.title: Language

near.description: A mall, hotel or attraction name to search within 1.5 km of, e.g. 'Pavilion KL', 'Suria KLCC', 'Mid Valley Megamall'. Unknown names are refused (use area or city instead). Coordinates are not accepted.
near.title: Near

occasion.description: One of the occasion ids listed in the description.
occasion.title: Occasion

name: recommend_picks
title: Recommend places for an occasion
